title: Two Young Boys Outside Suburban Home, 1948 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
2 1/2 yrs old

Michael Jr & George Jr

at Aunt Mildred

July 1948

11864
description: A charming post-WWII black and white snapshot taken in July 1948 featuring two young boys, identified on the back as Michael Jr. and George Jr. The younger boy, around two and a half years old, wears light-colored summer overalls over sandals, while the older boy crouches behind him protectively holding his arms, dressed in a collared short-sleeve shirt and rolled-up trousers. They are posed along a paved pathway outside a classic American suburban home with light horizontal siding, a red brick foundation, and scalloped photo edges typical of the late 1940s baby boom era.
